# v0.18

Released 2026-11-23.

## Highlights

- Per-account remembered logins: each remembered rider keeps its own WebKit session, so
  the account picker signs straight back in. Unchecking "Remember me" now forgets the
  token and cached rider on exit, and when no account is remembered the registration
  page is shown.
- Launcher icons: switched to a bundled Tabler icon set, saving ~1 MB — the
  transitively-staged Adwaita icon theme is dropped entirely. An icon-vs-text mode was
  added alongside it for accessibility and the OCR-based test suites.
- The rider picker uses native keyboard navigation, and the log pane opens at a capped
  width.
- Build and packaging: the Wine build keeps only the DLLs and programs Zwift needs,
  shaving ~116 MiB off the snap (369 MiB to 253 MiB, about a third); the locale, man and
  iso-codes trees that arrive with the WebKit stack are dropped too (~6.6 MB packed). The
  version and prune steps are faster.
- Release tooling: a tagged release pipeline (build/verify, then Store + GitHub Release)
  and a release skill, plus the release notes for v0.8 to v0.17.
